NAVJYOT CHAWARE

Process Associate

+91- 9765646784 • Nagpur , India • njnavjyot1998@gmail.com • https://www.linkedin.com/in/navjyot- chaware SUMMARY Analytical finance professional with focus on quantifiable benefits, along with a solid foundation in capital market principles and financial analysis. Proven expertise in R2R process, FIS - Intellimatch systems, and data analytics. Skilled in process automation and enthusiastic about leveraging machine learning to drive financial innovation and efficiency.

WORK EXPERIENCE Transcom India - Gurugram, India (Onsite)

02/2026 - Ongoing

Clearing & Settlement Associate • Managed broker-to-broker and broker-to-bank securities transfers (FOP) using SWIFT MT540/MT542, ensuring

accurate settlement through Clearstream Exact manual matching.

Executed daily position reconciliation (MT535) of internal holdings against custodian records, swiftly resolving ingestion failures to maintain accurate customer positions.

Performed CBF/CBL realignment via Clearstream Xact, synchronizing operational positions between Frankfurt and Luxembourg systems for seamless settlement.

Oversaw delivery management on settlement date, ensuring timely release of sell instructions to mitigate buy-in risk, undelivered trades, and delayed cash credits.

Conducted TD+1 settlement instruction reconciliation (SI Recon), aligning internal aggregates with external partner data to prevent unmatched instructions, settlement delays, fail fees, and buy-in costs.

Carried out daily transaction reconciliation (MT536), investigating breaks and coordinating with custodians to resolve cancellations or missing entries, ensuring operational accuracy.

Managed inheritance portfolio transfers with full compliance, resolved regulatory complaints and escalations (BaFin) through detailed case analysis, and maintained day-to-day clearing and settlement operations with high standards of efficiency and accountability.

Tata Consultancy Services - Nagpur, India (Onsite)

09/2023 – 12/2025

Process Associate – Morgan Stanley & Int. PLC Project – BFSI • Led end-to-end cash and position reconciliations, identifying and resolving client data issues, trade breaks, and aged reconciliation breaks through in-depth analysis of cash balances, transaction bookings, and accounting entries; ensured timely escalation and closure of high-risk items in line with SLAs and internal controls. • Executed daily SOD/EOD calls with stakeholders to resolve client queries proactively, ensuring high standards of responsiveness and satisfaction. Skilled in resolving discrepancies, streamlining workflows, and ensuring accurate financial operations.

Managed client asset segregation and reconciliation processes in strict accordance with FCA’s CASS rules, maintaining client funds in segregated accounts to safeguard assets in the event of firm insolvency and ensure regulatory compliance. Perform bank account reconciliation to ensure accuracy and completeness of financial transactions.

Acted as a key liaison with internal and external stakeholders including Senior Operations, Trade Support, IT, custodians, and Portfolio Managers to research discrepancies, understand data dependencies and workflows, and ensure accurate, timely completion of client accounts while strengthening cross-functional relationships. • Manage share and bond movement processes, including tracking and reconciling transactions. Custody



shares movement approval to Settlements /Asset Services / PB/IPB & PWM Ops Supported daily operations within International Prime Brokerage, ensuring timely trade settlements and accurate reconciliations. Monitored client positions, margin requirements, and funding to maintain operational efficiency.

Utilized deep domain expertise in trade lifecycle management, equity, derivatives, fixed income, and syndicated loan operations to facilitate seamless settlements and trade position reconciliations

Collaborate with cross-functional teams to streamline reconciliation processes and improve efficiency. APAC, EMEA & NA region Cash & Equity reconciliation.

Prepare detailed reports and analysis for management review, Hands on with Applications- Qwest, SafeGUI, Intellimatch, Aqua Client Money, PB Today, Mainframe for Stock loan

• Drove team performance and process excellence by reviewing deliverables, maintaining error logs, identifying

process pain points and risk areas, and conducting targeted training sessions; leveraged advanced Excel skills

(Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP, shortcuts) to prepare management reports, enhance controls, and improve break- resolution efficiency.

Shriram Finance – Nagpur, India (Internship) Junior Executive - Audit • Conducted internal and branch audits to ensure compliance and process efficiency. • Prepared MIS reports highlighting audit findings and recommendations. • Analyzed NPA data to support risk assessment and improve portfolio quality. • Monitored branch expenses to maintain cost control and policy compliance. • process gaps and suggested improvements to strengthen controls. • Collaborated with branch teams to resolve audit queries and improve practices. • Ensured data accuracy in financial and regulatory reporting.

05/2023 – 08/2023

EDUCATION

The RTM Nagpur University [BBA]

Bachelor Of Business Administration [2022]

OTHER DETAILS

ERP Systems • FIS - Intelli match, Tally ERP, Euroclear • MS – Office, Excel VBA(Basic)

Languages • English, Hindi, Marathi
